meta.title: Acceleration Converter — Convert Meter/sec² and More
meta.description: Free acceleration converter for 4+ units including Meter/sec², Standard Gravity, Foot/sec². Instant, accurate, browser-based.

content.intro: m/s², g-force, ft/s². Fast, accurate conversions with engineering-grade precision for everyday and professional use. Convert between 4 acceleration units instantly, with engineering-grade precision and no signup required.
content.result_section: Pick any two units below to convert between them. The base unit for acceleration in this tool is **mps2**; every conversion routes through it for consistency.
content.formula_section: Most acceleration conversions are a single multiplication by a fixed factor. Temperature is the notable exception — it uses additive offsets, not just multiplication. The converter handles both transparently.
content.conversion_table:
| Unit | Symbol |
| --- | --- |
| Meter/sec² | m/s² |
| Standard Gravity | g |
| Foot/sec² | ft/s² |
| Galileo | Gal |
content.use_cases:
- Reading datasheets where SI and imperial units appear side by side.
- Cross-checking CAD drawings against fabrication specs in a different system.
- Converting torque, pressure, or stress values for procurement.
- Translating field measurements into engineering reports.
- Spec'ing parts from international suppliers.
content.tips:
Bookmark the conversions you use most — each pair has its own dedicated page with formulas, a lookup table, and FAQs.

When working with derived units (area, volume), remember the factor scales with the dimension: a length factor f becomes f² for area and f³ for volume.
content.faq:
**Q:** How accurate is this acceleration converter?
**A:** It uses 4 canonical unit definitions and 12-digit precision constants.

**Q:** Is it free?
**A:** Yes — completely free, no signup, no limits.

**Q:** Which units are supported?
**A:** Meter/sec² (m/s²), Standard Gravity (g), Foot/sec² (ft/s²), Galileo (Gal).
